name: Frenchly
description: Frenchly is an AI-powered French exam prep platform for TEF Canada and TCF Canada, built specifically for Express Entry candidates seeking CRS points. It offers CEFR-aligned lessons, structured learning paths, full mock exams, and practice for all four exam sections (reading, listening, writing, speaking), with Sophie—an AI voice tutor providing feedback on grammar, vocabulary, and fluency. Designed for phone-based studying a few minutes a day, with daily usage limits (about 40 AI actions and 5 minutes of voice practice). The platform emphasizes transparency: it is not affiliated with official exams or IRCC, makes no score guarantees, and is not a live human tutor or immigration service. Pricing: full access free for one month (no card required), then $39.99/month (cancel anytime); after the free month, users permanently keep all their progress and scores for free even if they do not subscribe.
